seo.title: D-100 — HPLC system for HbA1c by Bio-Rad | LabWell
seo.description: D-100 is an automated Bio-Rad HPLC system for HbA1c testing at 80 tests per hour. For medium- and high-volume laboratories. Service in Ukraine by LabWell.

T2_hero.lead: An automated Bio-Rad system for medium- and high-volume laboratories that need continuous HbA1c testing.

image.alt: D-100 Hemoglobin Testing System, front view

T3_about.h2: What D-100 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: D-100 is an automated Bio-Rad HPLC system for HbA1c measurement. It is designed for medium- and high-volume laboratories that need continuous HbA1c testing. Its throughput supports planning a routine workload without moving to a different measurement method.

rows.label: Operating conditions
rows.value: 15–35 °C; 20–80% relative humidity, non-condensing; altitude up to 3,048 m

items.text: Buffer can be replaced while the system is running, helping the laboratory maintain a continuous testing workflow. According to the manufacturer, the software automatically reviews and flags results for easier review.
RFID tags on the cartridge, calibrator and reagents carry lot, expiry and assay parameter data. The system reads this information automatically.
Manufacturer-specified temperature and humidity ranges help a laboratory assess installation requirements in advance. Power and storage requirements are listed in the specifications.

items.q: What is the D-100 system used for?
items.a: D-100 is used for HbA1c measurement by HPLC in medium- and high-volume laboratories.

items.q: What is the throughput of D-100?
items.a: D-100 has a throughput of 80 tests per hour.
The system reads RFID tags on the cartridge, calibrator and reagents for lot, expiry and assay parameter data.
LabWell is a Bio-Rad partner and supplier in Ukraine.

T12_contact.text: Tell us about your HbA1c workload and laboratory conditions, and we will help assess the system, configuration and required materials.
